definitions.explanation: Describes something that gives pleasure or enjoyment.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{楽|たの}しかったです。
この{本|ほん}は{楽|たの}しいです。
{一緒|いっしょ}に{遊|あそ}ぶのは{楽|たの}しいです。
{夏休|なつやす}みは{海|うみ}で{泳|およ}いだり、{山|やま}に{行|い}ったりして、とても{楽|たの}しかったです。
examples.english: During summer vacation, I swam in the sea and went to the mountains—it was really fun.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{話|はな}すのは{楽|たの}しいですが、{一人|ひとり}で{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むのも{楽|たの}しいです。
examples.english: Talking with friends is fun, but reading books alone is also fun.

notes:
RELATED FORMS:
- {楽|たの}しむ (verb): to enjoy
- {楽|たの}しみ (noun): enjoyment, pleasure, anticipation
- {楽|たの}しみにする: to look forward to
- お{楽|たの}しみください: please enjoy (polite)

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {楽|らく} has two main readings:
- たのしい: fun, enjoyable (emotional pleasure)
- らく: comfortable, easy, effortless (physical ease)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {楽|たの}しい{時間|じかん}を{過|す}ごす: to spend an enjoyable time
- {楽|たの}しみにしています: I'm looking forward to it (polite)
